Peripherals talk to the base station over a sub-GHz proprietary radio. Signal strength (RSSI) is shown in Device Settings > Device Info. Above -70 dBm is good, -70 to -80 dBm is acceptable, below -80 dBm causes intermittent disconnections, delayed notifications and choppy live view. Concrete walls, metal doors and fridges strongly attenuate the signal. Fix: move the device or base station, or install the official RP-1 repeater.

complaint: Our garage camera has been offline for two days. The garage is at the far end of the house, so I assume the signal is just too weak out there. Is there a booster or repeater I can buy? Everything else seems to work fine and I haven't changed anything in the app.
usability_reason: The response is clear and polite, and it correctly avoids recommending a repeater by noting the camera failed even at close range. However, actionability is weak: it defers to engineering with no troubleshooting steps, and the root-cause claim (hardware fault in the radio/board) is not supported by the session record—the customer only reported the camera didn't come online next to the base station, with no diagnostic confirming a hardware fault. The RSSI value and power-on event are presented as evidence but were not established in the recorded customer interaction.
